pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment with NaOH at varying pH values (8, 9, 10, 11) combined with mechanical disintegration using an IKA T25 Ultra Turrax Digital disperser at different rpm ranges (4000–24,000) for varying durations (15–180 min).

Alkaline pretreatment with KOH at varying pH values (8, 9, 10, 11) combined with mechanical disintegration using an IKA T25 Ultra Turrax Digital disperser at different rpm ranges (4000–24,000) for varying durations (15–180 min).

Batch anaerobic digestion of pretreated and untreated dairy waste activated sludge under mesophilic conditions (35 °C, 220 rpm) with a residence time of 42 days, utilizing rumen micro-organisms as inoculum.
